name: Sun/Earth differential gravity and non-inertial trajectory
purpose: Verify U04 terms are applied by the linked mover.
production_capability: SPICE state update, Moon force callback, and second-order mover.
configuration: DE421 epoch baseline; shadowed -3 lunar-radii fixture; 300 s with dt=5 s.
inputs: raw SPICE force-state vectors emitted by executable
independent_reference: Separate RK4 integration of point gravity, differential gravity, centrifugal and Coriolis equations.
units: m, m s^-1, m s^-2, rad s^-1, s
frame_time_convention: Moon-centred rotating LSO; SPICE ET/TDB state frozen by production hook.
deterministic_stochastic_controls: Single shadowed particle; no stochastic source.
procedure: Advance linked particle and compare with 32768-step independent RK4.
expected_pass_result: Linked trajectory agrees with the independent frozen-state ODE.
status_semantics: PASS is linked numerical agreement at this fixture, not long-duration convergence.
